finalText:
Found it. `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` merged layers with a plain `Object.assign`, so any package overriding part of `output` or `sourcemap` (like `@acme/api` setting `output.format`) wiped out the rest of that nested object — losing `dir` and `mode`.

I changed it to merge one level deep, so overrides only touch the keys they name. Build now finishes clean: `74.3s with 5 warnings, 0 errors`, and `verify.js` confirms it.
